Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre- Qualification Criteria: a) Technical Criteria 1. The bidder must be a company/firm in the field of Shipping/Vessel Management h aving its registered office in India. The copy of the registration certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies/Registrar of firms with the Articles of Association t o be submitted as a proof of document. 2. The bidding company/firm must have prior experience of five years in the similar services (Total management of vessels) with reference to the last date of submission under this tender. The bidder must also have rendered similar service s as detailed in the scope of this tender for a period of minimum one-year continuous operation for a minimum of two vessels of 1000 GT capacity & 60m L OA. (in case of a consortium bid, the lead member of the consortium should meet the abov e technical criteria). The bidders must produce the copies of the Work order issued by the Owners of t he Vessel/Agreement entered between the bidder and the vessel owner, work co mpletion/ performance certificate containing the nature of work performed, perio d and the consideration/fee for the services received. In addition to the above, c opy of vessel registry, including Continuous Synopsis Record (CSR) issued by flag administration, Safety Management Certificate (SMC) issued by classification soci ety shall also be attached for the experience claimed by the bidder. All document s to be endorsed by a notary. 3. Management Experience: The technical personnel [operating and manning the of fice] should have a minimum of five years’ experience with reference to the last date of submission under this tender. The technical personnel shall compris e of one Certified Marine Engineer with MEO Class 1 and one Master mariner certi ficate holder and two Marine Engineers [ETO] with experience in Marine/Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Credentials of the personnel [Appointment letter with COC copies] to be s ubmitted as a proof document. 4. Bidding Firm should have valid Document of Compliances (DOC) for “other cargo ships” type for a minimum period of one year within the last five years. Copy of DOC issued by maritime administration of a flag state or classifica tion society acting on behalf, is to be provided. 5. The bidder should have executed during the preceding five years similar services as detailed in the scope of this tender for any one of the following values and mu st attach documentary proof for the execution of services. a. One work order executed for similar services (Total management of ves sels) for a value of INR 15.2 Crores or equivalent currency or b. Two work orders executed for similar services (Total management of ve ssels) for a value of INR 9.5 Crores or equivalent currency or c. Three work orders executed for similar services (Total management of vessels) for a value of INR 7.6 Crores or equivalent currency. [Note: "Total Management" means the operation of the vessel, providing crew an d support staff, maintenance and the compliance under the statutory regulations relating to Vessels.] b) Financial Criteria

1. A. Turn Over: The average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years, ending on ‘31st March 2026, should be at least INR 57 cror es as per the audited report (profit & loss account), duly authenticated by a Char tered Accountant/Cost Accountant in India. (in case of a consortium bid, the turnover of each member of consortium will be added together for the respe ctive financial year and the average will be arrived towards annual turnover. Further the lead member of the consortium should meet atleast 50% of the annual turnover criteria as mentioned above.) The annual turnover certificate for last three years, year ending 31.03.2026 of the bidder or all partners of consortium, duly certified by Chartered Accountant /Cost Accountant shall be submitted as per the format (Annexure-I) 2. A. The net worth should not be negative year ending 31.03.2026 and also should not have eroded by more than 30% (thirty percent) in last three years, year endi ng 31.03.2026. The net worth of consortium firm should not be negative year end ing 31.03.2026 and also should not have eroded by more than 30% (thirty percen t) in last three years, year ending 31.03.2026. The net worth certificates for last three years, Year ending 31.03.2026 of the bidder and lead partners of consortium, shall be duly certified by Chartered Ac countant/Cost Accountant and shall be submitted as per the format (Annexure- I) .
